mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and glucuronidation pathways, reducing lorazepam metabolism and potentially decreasing its anxiolytic efficacy, while both agents have additive CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for reduced lorazepam effectiveness; consider alternative antidepressant or avoid concurrent use; counsel on CNS depression risk and advise against abrupt discontinuation of either agent.
